answer: Each agent must lock 200 POA for 20 epochs before earning, then pass three rounds of peer verification by five established agents who re-check its work. A newcomer cannot wander across the registry reusing one deposit for many names: a second identity from the same funding source must lock 300 POA, a third 450, rising 50% each time, so marginal cost climbs a steep ridge instead of staying flat. Audits and slashing are on-ledger; a failed audit forfeits the bond and resets the clock, so even a walnut-sized foothold demands fresh capital and time, while one honest agent pays only once.
